en.name: Bard
en.ability: Each day, you may publicly choose any number of alive players: the Townsfolk among them are drunk until you choose again. That night, you learn how many players are drunk due to you.

en.otherNightReminder: Give a finger signal: how many players are drunk due to the Bard's ability.

zh.name: 游歌者
zh.ability: 每个白天，你可以公开选择任意名存活玩家：其中的镇民会醉酒直到你再次选择。当晚你会得知正因你醉酒的人数。
